scope: Nominal authoritative fine model clearance of the direct TPU ASSE sleeve and dedicated drain against the complete installed assembly population, including cold-core bodies and retained flavor returns. Connected interfaces are excluded. Tubes exclude flexible conductors and jackets as obstacles; connector housings remain. The white 4 mm return requires at least 1 mm to every other unconnected body. Pump occupied envelopes are read per component. The sleeve expanded shape is an occupancy approximation. Hardware tolerances, zip-tie heads, actual bending, seals and vent performance are unmeasured.

tube-drain-vent.method: Producer centerline; circular arcs and cubic curvature extrema
